issue.title: Bob Refs Tabs filter — a Highlights tab switcher
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture's Bob Refs panel, ⇧⌘O pressed while Highlights is frontmost (or ⌘T inside the panel) shows a "Tabs" filter. It lists every document open in Highlights, matched to its reference note where one exists, with the current tab first and the previous tab pre-selected. ↵ switches to that existing tab without touching the vault or the open log. Bob Mac Capture installs with a stable signing identity, so the Accessibility grant the feature needs survives every `just install`.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md requests this work

issue.title: Stable signing identity and Accessibility status
issue.description: signing: `just install` signs with a stable self-signed "Bob Mac Capture Local" identity when it exists, and otherwise falls back to ad-hoc with a loud warning. `bundle.sh` keeps its ad-hoc default for agent scratch builds. The ad-hoc warning now mentions Accessibility. Settings › References shows "Highlights tabs: Allowed / Not allowed" through a small AccessibilityTrust helper. The README documents creating the identity.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md defines phase signing as one work unit

issue.title: RefsCore tab snapshot, matcher, ordering, and session
issue.description: tabs-core: pure Foundation types in RefsCore. They cover the snapshot, the reader protocol and its results, the full-path → unique-file-name → collision → none matcher, the A5 ordering and pre-selection, the stale-target locator, tab recency, the scoped and searchable tabs listing, the "N tabs" count text, the `.inHighlights` section, and a main-actor session that owns generations and recency. Golden tests run with `just portable-check`.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md defines phase tabs-core as one work unit

issue.title: Highlights-only Accessibility reader
issue.description: ax-reader: `AXHighlightsTabsReader` in BobMacCapture implements the RefsCore reader protocol, using only public AX API against Highlights' process. It never launches Highlights, never prompts, and works off the main actor with messaging timeouts and a time budget. It reads window AXDocument and the native tab bar, and presses one verified tab button for select. Tab names stay in memory only. An optional read-only probe runs on the Mac.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md defines phase ax-reader as one work unit

issue.title: Panel model Tabs filter, switching, and states
issue.description: tabs-model: RefsPanelModel gains the presentation source, the `tabsFilter` flag, the tabs state, and the tab-row map. It handles ⌘T and ⌘R re-snapshots, the Esc/⌫ ladder, and a ↵ held until the first snapshot lands. Matched rows switch through `openInHighlights` without `recordOpen`; collision and unmatched rows switch through the session's select, with a stale-tab banner. Synthetic rows survive library publications. Preview hooks and model tests use a fake reader.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md defines phase tabs-model as one work unit

issue.title: Tabs rendering, keys, and design tests
issue.description: tabs-views: the Tabs token and "9 tabs" count in the search bar, the In Highlights header, the "Current · p. N/M" pill, dim file-name rows for collision and unmatched tabs, minimal inspector cards, and cards for every Tabs state. Also the "↵ Switch" footer, VoiceOver labels, and router bindings for ⌘T and the ⌫ context, plus design fixtures and router tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tabs_switcher.md defines phase tabs-views as one work unit

issue.title: ⇧⌘O entry point, live wiring, settings, and docs
issue.description: tabs-entry: adds `HotKeyAction.refsHighlightsTabs = 4` with a configurable ⇧⌘O/⌘E/Off key that registers only while Highlights is frontmost, and splits the hotkey dispatch so ⌘O and ⌃⇧⌘O are unchanged. Adds coordinator toggle-to-Tabs semantics, wires the live AX reader, session, and ad-hoc flag, and samples recency when Highlights deactivates. Adds the Settings key picker and the README Tabs, keyboard, privacy, and troubleshooting docs, plus the optional decision record.
